title: Correlation of energy disorder and open-circuit voltage in hybrid perovskite solar cells

extraction_issues.quote: The $ \mathrm{M A P b I}{3} $ layers were formed by the interdiffusion of lead iodide $ (\mathrm{P b I}{2}) $ and a methyl ammonium iodide $ (\mathrm{C H}{3} \mathrm{N H}{3} \mathrm{I}, \mathrm{C H}{3} \mathrm{N H}{3}=\mathrm{M A}) $ stacking layer
extraction_issues.reason: 化学式下标丢失：$\mathrm{MAPbI}{3}$ 应为 $\mathrm{MAPbI_{3}}$，$\mathrm{PbI}{2}$ 应为 $\mathrm{PbI_{2}}$，$\mathrm{CH}{3}\mathrm{NH}{3}\mathrm{I}$ 应为 $\mathrm{CH_{3}NH_{3}I}$，$\mathrm{CH}{3}\mathrm{NH}{3}$ 应为 $\mathrm{CH_{3}NH_{3}}$，下标 3/2 被错误置于花括号外。

extraction_issues.quote: the device PCE increased from 17.1 % to 19.4 %. The increasing of PCE here mainly comes from the $ \mathrm{V{O C}} $ enhancement from 1.04 V to 1.13 V
extraction_issues.reason: $\mathrm{V_{OC}}$ 被抽取为 $\mathrm{V{O C}}$，下标 OC 丢失，符号表示损坏。
